svg.title: Memorial candles express remembrance rather than a costume celebration.

text.tspan: Memorial candles express remembrance rather than a costume celebration.
commemoration
US /kəˌmɛməˈreɪʃən/ noun
Singular: commemoration; plural: commemorations.
An act or event held to honor the memory of a person or a
past event.
remembrance; memorial observance · A celebration may
be joyful; a commemoration centers on remembering and
honoring.
The neighborhood held a candlelit commemoration for
residents who had died during the previous year.
Common patterns: a commemoration of an event; a
ceremony in commemoration of someone. Do not assume
Halloween and remembrance observances are the same
tradition.
A: Are the candles part of the costume festival?
B: No. They’re for a separate commemoration in the
square.
A: Is it appropriate for visitors to attend?
B: Yes. The organizers ask people to keep their voices low
and leave the candles undisturbed.
An invitation reads: “Come to our commemoration—a loud
costume contest with prizes!” What expectation does
commemoration create, and which word better fits the
advertised event?
